intro: Viewer Foundation is the built-in home for viewer points and levels. Below your settings you get a points list with every viewer's name and total, where you can add, remove or set points, delete a viewer, and export or import the whole list.

sections.title: 1. Name and manage progression
sections.description: Name your points, then turn on earning.

sections.title: 2. Optional cross-platform account links
sections.description: Only link accounts you know are the same person.

sections.title: 4. Active and lurk time
sections.description: Active time is settled when viewers keep chatting inside the activity window. Lurk time begins with the configured lurk command and settles on their next message or stream-offline event.
sections.notice: Set the active window at least as long as the required active minutes; StreamBridge safely raises it when needed. Repeating !lurk does not reset the original start time. Platforms do not expose a dependable cross-platform list of silent viewers, so merely opening a stream cannot be verified.

sections.title: 5. Community events
sections.description: Choose fixed awards for follows, redemptions, and raids.

sections.title: 6. Support events
sections.description: Fixed points per event. Not based on money.

sections.title: 7. Levels and achievements
sections.description: Same points, same level. Achievements come from points.

sections.title: 8. Privacy and storage limits
sections.description: Least-recently-seen records are removed at the viewer cap. Codes that stop double counting expire automatically.
sections.notice: Private data holds one random install code, viewer IDs, each viewer's latest name and platform, point totals, levels, limited activity counters and times, and short codes that stop events counting twice. Chat text and real platform IDs are never stored here.

sections.title: 9. Rewards bought with points
sections.description: Viewers on any platform type a command and pay with points instead of Twitch channel points.
sections.notice: Each row is one reward. Add the Twitch reward ID to make Hydration, Reward Timers, Face Filters, Critter Catch and other extensions react as if the Twitch reward was redeemed. Without an ID, extensions that match rewards by name still react. Jukebox, Viewer Spotlight, Free Game Check, Village Voice and Roll Call already have their own points commands. Points are not given back if an extension turns the reward down; a moderator can add them back in the points list. Restart StreamBridge after changing commands.
